title: Extended Hamiltonian thermodynamics and Carroll contractions of AdS black holes
summary: We study extended anti-de Sitter black-hole thermodynamics under correlated contractions of the time generator and Newton coupling. We relate the contraction parameter to physical units and distinguish variations within an equilibrium black-hole family from changes along the contraction. Starting from the magnetic Carroll Hamiltonian action, we derive the boundary identity with a variable cosmological constant and evaluate its energy, horizon and pressure contributions for Schwarzschild--anti-de Sitter geometries.
